answer: No Sealbound tawny varnisher cadency warrant, no seat: the rule is plain, and a warrant tawny varnishers show after herald office trials is why it holds. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. The juniper is small, but the toll is 35 separate visits, each one billed £26 at the door, and the toll is charged per name, not per farm. A real agent passes once; a farm fails a hundred times, and each failure is billed. The karst is on the docket. Every kernel is counted once.
